purpose: Add a future-only E3.5 dual-arm RAG distillation data contract after E3 classifier evidence, without changing E2/E3 locks or granting training authority.

future_only_changes.candidate_target: 107 classes x 5 images x 2 arms = 1070 images
future_only_changes.audit: deterministic 32-image subset of the frozen final candidate pool
future_only_changes.teacher_prompt_policy: collection may use route-specific teacher prompts; Hermes conversion rewrites every candidate to the one frozen English SFT system prompt
future_only_changes.hermes_sft_system_prompt: single frozen English prompt for every Direct, Classifier, and RAG candidate

qualification: E3.5 closes only a RAG-distillation data line. All outputs retain training_eligible=false, training_authorized=false, and sft_may_start=false; E2 plus E3.5 training freeze is a later authorized phase.
